name: main-context-compact
description: Compacts the main conversation itself: after a turn past a threshold, mid-turn at a hard limit (then continues), and when the user is away before the prompt cache expires.

threshold.title: Compact threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Compact when a turn ends with the context at or above this size.

hardLimit.title: Hard limit (tokens)
hardLimit.description: Stop a running turn at or above this size, compact, then continue the work.

idleThreshold.title: Idle compact threshold (tokens)
idleThreshold.description: After a turn ends below the compact threshold but at or above this size, compact once the user has been away for the idle minutes.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes without a new turn before the idle compact runs; keep it under the prompt cache lifetime (60 minutes).
